# Properties: recognized fields, ignored unsupported input, and literal prose

## Input boundary

```````````````````````````````` example
---
title: Note
tags: [a, b]
---
Body
.
Document scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..4:3 children=1
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:11 name="title" value=scalar(text("Note")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
└── Metadata scope=1:1..7:3 children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Recognized field semantics

```````````````````````````````` example
---
name: Note
time: 12:34
date: 2026-09-08
authors: [Ada, Lin]
keywords: [one, 2]
abstract: Summary
state: draft
comment: Note
---
body
.
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
├── Metadata scope=1:1..4:3 children=2
│   ├── MetadataRecord scope=2:1..2:12 name="authors" value=scalar(text("Ada")) children=0
│   └── MetadataRecord scope=3:1..3:18 name="keywords" value=scalar(text("language")) children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Fixed-field and text/list forms

```````````````````````````````` example
body
````````````````````````````````

## Fixed-field and text/list forms

```````````````````````````````` example
  before
→
  after
state: ready
````````````````````````````````

## Fixed-field and text/list forms
